articles.title: Tedeum, en vivo: ante Milei, García Cuerva defendió la inversión en discapacidad y pidió dejar atrás la "mezquindad política"
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the traditional Tedeum ceremony on July 9 at the Metropolitan Cathedral for Argentina's Independence Day, where Archbishop García Cuerva delivered a homily calling for unity and investment in vulnerable populations.

articles.title: Desde Tucumán, Milei llamó a los gobernadores a "sentar las bases para el futuro de una verdadera libertad"
articles.summary: President Milei delivered a speech during the July 9 vigil in Tucumán highlighting his administration's achievements including fiscal surplus, regulatory reforms, and calling governors to reaffirm commitment to the Pacto de Mayo.

articles.title: Ahora juega la casta: Javier Milei movió primero y fuerte para 2027
articles.summary: The government is working to reform electoral rules by eliminating primary elections and implementing a system of party listings while pursuing political alliances with governors to support Milei's 2027 reelection bid.

articles.title: Javier Milei puso la Casa Rosada a disposición de la Selección y prometió no estar presente
articles.summary: President Milei offered Casa Rosada for the national football team's potential World Cup celebration while discussing his administration's financial reforms including Central Bank Charter modifications and capital markets development.

articles.title: El Gobierno celebra el avance de la derecha en la región y mira con expectativa las elecciones de Brasil
articles.summary: President Milei expressed support for right-wing electoral victories in Peru and Colombia, confirmed attendance at their presidential inaugurations, and openly backed opposition to Brazil's current government ahead of October elections.
